lines.t: I lay my burden at your feet You are mercy, you are sweet
When the night was close and I could not see Your voice of truth was calling me
I was wondering, I was warned But you found me in the storm
You spoke peace into my fear And now I know that you are near
You are holy, you are near I bow in awe, I bow in fear
You are worthy, you are light The darkness trembles at your sight
I worship you, spirit and truth
My heart is yours, my life is proof
My king, my song, my endless praise
I will dwell in your holy ways
I lift my voice, I lift my hands
I surrender to your plans
Forevermore my soul will sing
All honor to my righteous King
You broke the chains that held my soul
You made the wounded spirit whole
You called me out of heaviness
And wrapped me in your tenderness
Every scar and every tear
You have turned them into cheer
Now every breath and every day
Belongs to you, I give you praise
You are holy, you are near
I bow in awe, I bow in fear
You are worthy, you are light
The darkness trembles at your sight
I worship you, spirit and truth
My heart is yours, my life is proof
My king, my song, my endless praise I will dwell in your holy ways
I lift my voice, I lift my hands I surrender to your plans
Forevermore my soul will sing All honor to my righteous king
In the quiet of the night, you become my guiding light
When the world is loud and vain, you remain the same, the same
I will seat your face above, I will rest inside your love
Teach me how to walk your way, lead me in your truth each day
You are holy, You are near I bow in awe, I bow in fear
You are worthy, You are light The darkness trembles at Your sight
My King, lift up my eyes You reign forever high and high
My King, take all I am
And I surrender to the Lamb
Yahushua, hear my song
You were faithful all along
Yahushua, take the throne
Don't let your glory be known
